system.description:
Prerequisites: Intermediate Dominate, Intermediate Presence. Any Toreador who regards a scene or work of great beauty is prone to fall into an aesthetic stupor. Those familiar with the power of Bliss can recall beauty almost as intimately as if it were before them and use this as a reservoir of inner strength, a bulwark against the irrational desires, frenzies, and fears of the Beast. The Kindred may also project this sense of pleasure upon another, calming them from the throes of rage or frenzy. Bliss can be used only by vampires on the Path of Humanity.

System: To use this power, the Toreador must deliberately enter a trance while watching, listening to, or looking at some work of art or embodiment of beauty, remaining enthralled until the experience ends. Within one scene after the trance ends, the player makes an Intelligence + Survival roll, difficulty equal to double the current rating of the Virtue to be raised. Success temporarily increases Self-Control, Conscience, or Courage by one dot for the remainder of the scene (only one Virtue at a time), and the source of the trance must be thematically appropriate to the Virtue chosen. When used to steel the resolve of another, the roll is Wits + Expression instead, and the difficulty increases by one. Botching any roll costs a Willpower point (minimum 1).

MET System: The prerequisites are identical: the character must enter a trance while observing art. Within one hour or one scene after the trance ends, the player must make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty equal to double the desired Trait's permanent value. If successful, he may add one Trait to Self-Control, Conscience, or Courage for the remainder of the hour or scene (only one Virtue at a time). When used to steel another's resolve, the difficulty equals double the target's Virtue, plus one.

Costs 7 Experience Traits to learn (14 experience points in the tabletop system).
system.prerequisites: Dominate (2), Presence (2); usable only by vampires on the Path of Humanity
